name: Red Dawn: Night 1

date.source: CAWO's own two-part results column, both parts posted 30 April 2016 to its fwrestling.com forum, recapping the debut Allstate Arena pay-per-view

appearances.source: CAWO's own Red Dawn Night 1 results column, opening segment: Skinner welcomes the crowd as CAWO Central's own chief executive
CAWO's own Red Dawn Night 1 results column: Oswald directs the Empirical State's run-in on the Atlantic title match and again brawls ringside during the tag title final
CAWO's own Red Dawn Night 1 results column: Montgomery brawls ringside with the Covenant of Darkness during the tag title final
CAWO's own Red Dawn Night 1 results column: Diabolous brawls ringside with the Empirical State during the tag title final
CAWO's own Red Dawn Night 1 results column: a masked figure in a backstage vignette immediately before the main event is named on-air as "this man the Minstrel"

matches.note: Ladder match for the vacant CAWO Atlantic Regional Heavyweight Championship. McCain retrieved the belt after Christian Avant and Salvatore Bocanegra, unrequested, knocked Nado from the ladder; McCain became the first-ever CAWO champion of any kind.
Two-out-of-three-falls match for the vacant CAWO Central Regional Heavyweight Championship. Lazarus won the first fall; Marshall won the second by count-out and the third with a side-swipe powerbomb.
CAWO World Tag Team Championship tournament semi-final. Abomination (Wraith and the Apparition) advanced to the final.
Submission match for the vacant CAWO Pacific Regional Heavyweight Championship. O'Neil forced Red Claw to submit to a crossface.
CAWO World Tag Team Championship tournament semi-final. Sex & Violence advanced to the final.
Cage match for the vacant CAWO International Regional Heavyweight Championship. Cromier submitted Franco with a modified anaconda vice.

CAWO World Tag Team Championship tournament final, the show's main event. Abomination pinned Sex & Violence to become the first-ever CAWO World Tag Team Champions, despite a brawl at ringside between the Empirical State and the Covenant of Darkness stables.

notes: Served across two posted parts (both cited under this one show). CAWO's own advertised Red Dawn Night 2, meant to crown its first World Heavyweight Champion via an eight-man tournament, never produced a results document anywhere on the record.

name: Red Dawn: Night 2 (World Heavyweight Title Tournament)

date.source: CAWO's own advertised lineup (27 April 2016) scheduled Night 2 for the day after Night 1 (30 April 2016); the operator's own 2 June 2016 status post still describes it as forthcoming

evidence.source: CAWO's own advertised Red Dawn lineup (27 April 2016) and the operator's own 2 June 2016 status post
evidence.note: An eight-man World Heavyweight Championship tournament was advertised (quarterfinals: John McDonough vs. Godzilla, Armand Arkynson vs. the Minstrel, Halcon vs. Diabolous, J.W. Oswald vs. Josh Hamlin) alongside a CAWO United States Title match never named in full; no results document for any of it survives on the record, and the operator's own last post treats it as still pending.

appearances.source: CAWO's own advertised Red Dawn lineup, 27 April 2016: a quarterfinal bout was advertised against Josh Hamlin
CAWO's own advertised Red Dawn lineup, 27 April 2016: a quarterfinal bout was advertised against Halcon
CAWO's own advertised Red Dawn lineup, 27 April 2016: a quarterfinal bout was advertised against Armand Arkynson

notes: Never resolved on the record; recorded as a collected:false stub per the honest-gap rule rather than invented. Several advertised participants (John McDonough, Godzilla, Armand Arkynson, Halcon, Josh Hamlin) are not minted as characters because nothing beyond a billed advertisement survives for them.
